# yt4ksaver

yt4ksaver is a free, browser-based utility that enables users to download YouTube video and audio content in various resolutions, including 4K and 8K, and formats like MP4 and MP3. It requires no user registration, account creation, or software installation.

## Key Features
- High-quality video downloading (up to 4K and 8K)
- High-fidelity audio extraction (MP3 at 320 kbps and 128 kbps)
- Interactive video trimming and section clipping
- Automatic YouTube subtitle downloader (SRT format)
- Automatic HD thumbnail grabber
- Purely browser-based operation, responsive on both mobile and desktop viewports

- [Terms of Service](https://yt4ksaver.com/terms.html) - Acceptable usage policy and copyright details.
